scripts.text: - You have too many items. Please make space. -
scripts.translation: - 您的物品栏已满，请腾出空间。 -

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
Look... the Magic Academy
in Geffen is now directly
selling the brand new
^007777Universal Catalog Silver^000000!
scripts.translation:
[目录魔法师]
看...吉芬的魔法学院
现在直接销售全新的
^007777通用目录 银版^000000！

scripts.text:
He is looking at the words
written on his hand.
He seems too busy
to look at you.
scripts.translation:
他正看着自己手上写的字。
他似乎太忙了，
没空看你。

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
A brand new catalog
has just come out!
You can check
what items you can trade
and what items are on sale
from the vendor.
scripts.translation:
[目录魔法师]
全新的目录刚出版！
你可以查看
可以交易的物品
以及商家正在促销的物品。

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
The ^007777Universal Catalog Silver^000000
costs only 200z!
You can buy up to 50 pieces at once!
scripts.translation:
[目录魔法师]
^007777通用目录 银版^000000
只要200 Zeny！
一次最多可以购买50本！
购买一本^007777通用目录 银版^000000

scripts.text: You don't look like a vendor!

[Catalog Magician]
You... want all 50 pieces?
Or how many do you need?
scripts.translation:
[目录魔法师]
你...想要全部50本？
还是说你需要多少本？

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
The trade has been stopped!
I don't know what to do next...
What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[目录魔法师]
交易被中断了！
我不知道接下来该怎么办...
我该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
It should be less than 50 pieces.
scripts.translation:
[目录魔法师]
应该少于50本。

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
The total number of catalog(s) that you're trying to purchase is {0} pieces.
It costs {1} z.
It seems you don't have enough money.
You can sell your equipment
to make more money... if you want.
scripts.translation:
[目录魔法师]
您试图购买的目录总数为{0}本。
费用为{1} Zeny。
看来您的Zeny不足。
您可以出售装备
来赚取更多Zeny...如果您愿意的话。

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
The total number of catalog(s) that you're trying to purchase is {0} pieces.
It costs {1} z.
Ok, here you go.
scripts.translation:
[目录魔法师]
您试图购买的目录总数为{0}本。
费用为{1} Zeny。
好的，给您。

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
Argh... you really need this
item... Do you want me to
explain again? I don't know
what to do next...
What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[目录魔法师]
啊...你真的需要这个
物品...你想让我再解释一遍吗？
我不知道接下来该怎么办...
我该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
My real job is a magician.
I was going to ask the merchant
guild to sell them, but they were
trying use them as an appendix
into broom sales. That's why
I'm selling these by myself.
scripts.translation:
[目录魔法师]
我的本职工作是魔法师。
我本来打算请商人行会
来销售这些目录，但他们试图
把它们作为扫帚销售的附录。
所以我才自己来卖这些。

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
There are many adventurers
here who come and go.
I'm pretty sure that I can sell to all of them soon.
Don't you think so?
So... let's start!! Buy more of them, please! PLEASE...!
scripts.translation:
[目录魔法师]
这里有很多来来去去的冒险者。
我确信很快就能把它们全部卖完。
你不觉得吗？
所以...让我们开始吧！！请多买一些！拜托了...！
